order_raw:
1. Anti-streptolysin O (ASO) titer and anti-DNase B antibodies.  
2. Serum ceruloplasmin, serum copper, and 24-hour urine copper.  
3. Thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4).  
4. Erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) and C-reactive protein (CRP).  
5. Complete blood count (CBC).  
6. Brain MRI without contrast.  
7. Lumbar puncture for cerebrospinal fluid analysis.  
8. Electroencephalogram (EEG).  
9. Therapeutic trial of intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG).
